name: MARA proxy unauthenticated swap entry point
summary: The MARA proxy exposes an unauthenticated payable entry point (selector 0x5fc985ea) that runs caller-supplied swap paths with the contract's own funds, letting the attacker skew the MARA pair inside a DODO flash loan and sell into it.
notes: Fourth and final Upgraded event before the exploit; it selected the implementation executed during the exploit.
The exploit receipt records exactly 8.8 WBNB transferred to the attacker EOA after the 11 WBNB DODO flash loan was repaid.
